title: MANSION HUB CYPHER (Dancehall × Future Beats) [98]
style: Jamaican dancehall meets future beats, 98 BPM, instrumental with chipmunk-pitched vocal chops only (no lead vocal, no rap), trilingual chop weave Jamaican Patois + Spanish + te reo Maori, classic dancehall steppers kick-snare pattern, deep sub bass with slides, organ stabs, sharp claps and rim shots, chopped horn stabs, dub delay throws, female chops pitched +6 and male chops at -3, sound-system-mansion-party mood, sidechain ducking pads to kick, club 2026 production, no profanity, no real-artist references
lyrics:
[Intro]
(dub delay throw, organ stab, sub pulse)
(MAN... SION... HUB...)
(yard... yard... yard...)
(casa... whare... home...)

[Build]
(steppers kick locks in, claps double up)
MAN — SION! HUB — LOCK!
YARD — STYLE! YARD — STYLE!
CASA! WHARE! HOME!
KEEL — CLEAR — GO!
(horn stab roll, riser sweep)

[Drop 1]
(full dancehall steppers, sub-heavy, organ stabs)
MAN — SION!
HUB — LOCK!
YARD — IN!
DOOR — OPEN!
(chop stack +7) bless-bless-si-si / āe-āe-bless-bless
THREE — THREE — SIX!
G4 — LENS — ON!

[Verse]
(half-time groove, organ solo, chops trade)
(who deh?) (quién?) (ko wai?)
(me deh!) (yo!) (au!)
(bless up!) (bendición!) (manaaki!)
McIVOR HOLDS THE KEY —
ZYNCONTEXT HOLDS THE LOOP —
SONGPAL HEARS THE CALL —
FINICH — NOT — FINISH!

[Breakdown]
(strip to organ + sub pulse, dub throws)
(whispered) mansion... hub...
(soft) yard... style...
(soft) casa... whare...
(piano lifts, soft chop)
KEEL... CLEAR...
THREE... THREE... SIX...
(claps build, horns return)

[Drop 2]
(double-time steppers, full stack, dub delays peak)
MAN — SION — HUB! (yard yard yard!)
LOCK — IN! (bendición! bless up!)
DOOR — OPEN! (manaaki! manaaki!)
KEEL — TAKE — OVER!
G4 — LENS — LOCKED!
THREE — THREE — SIX!
FINICH — NOT — FINISH!

[Outro]
(dub delay throws, organ resolves)
(mansion... hub... yard...)
(casa... whare... home...)
(KEEL... CLEAR...)
(sub pulse fades to silence)
